accounts.name: market
docs: Caller-supplied market keypair; becomes PDA seed for downstream PDAs.

accounts.name: userAccount
docs: PDA `[b"user", payer]`; auto-created on first claim.

instructions.name: Deposit
docs: Deposit debt-mint or collateral-mint atoms into the signer's seat.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Market staging vault PDA `[b"vault", market, mint]`.

accounts.name: marginfiAccount
docs: Lender or borrower marginfi account, side-determined.

instructions.name: Withdraw
docs: Withdraw withdrawable shares back to a wallet ATA.

accounts.name: debtOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic debt-oracle slice (PythPush = 1 acct, Staked = 3).

accounts.name: collateralOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic collateral-oracle slice.

instructions.name: PlaceOrder
docs: Place a primary order or secondary loan-sale bid.

accounts.name: debtOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic debt-oracle slice (PythPush = 1 acct, Staked = 3).

accounts.name: collateralOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic collateral-oracle slice.

accounts.name: lenderMarginfiAccount
docs: For P2Pool deposit-back path on Bids; also the route for the borrower-LTV check.

accounts.name: globalVault
docs: Vault PDA derived from `debt_mint`; reads/mutates vault makers in match.

instructions.name: CancelOrder
docs: Cancel an open order owned by the signer.

instructions.name: UpdateOrder
docs: Update an open order — cancel-and-replace; renews sequence.

instructions.name: ProcessMatchedLoan
docs: Promote a `MatchedLoan` queue entry into a `LoanFixed` PDA. Permissionless cranker.

accounts.name: loan
docs: Loan PDA `[b"loan", market, sequence]`; allocated on primary.

accounts.name: debtOracle
docs: Secondary only. First entry of the variadic debt oracle slice (PythPush = 1 acct, Staked = 3).

accounts.name: collateralOracle
docs: Secondary only. First entry of the variadic collateral oracle slice.

accounts.name: splitLoan
docs: SECONDARY|SPLIT only — fresh PDA `[b"split_loan", market, queue_seq]`.

accounts.name: globalVault
docs: Optional — appended when trigger seat is risk-profile-owned.

instructions.name: Repay
docs: Borrower repays principal + interest on an active loan.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Market staging vault PDA `[b"vault", market, debt_mint]`.

instructions.name: ClaimRepayment
docs: Wallet-lender claims accrued atoms from a repaid loan.

accounts.name: crankerRefund
docs: Optional — receives the loan PDA rent refund on full settle.

instructions.name: SyncMarketPosition
docs: Permissionless: copy canonical seat balances into the owner's mirror.

instructions.name: CreateVault
docs: Allocate the per-mint `GlobalVault` + init marginfi integration account.

instructions.name: CreateRiskProfile
docs: Insert a `RiskProfile` into the vault's tree.

instructions.name: GlobalVaultWithdraw
docs: Depositor burns shares to redeem atoms; reverts on deployed-not-available.

instructions.name: ClaimSeatForRiskProfile
docs: Curator opens a market seat for a profile with a per-market cap. Split-payer: feePayer covers tx fee + rent for the new seat block; curator only signs to satisfy the profile.curator gate.

accounts.name: feePayer
docs: Tx fee payer + rent funder for market seat-block expansion.

instructions.name: PlaceOrderForRiskProfile
docs: Curator places a vault Ask. Split-payer: feePayer covers tx fee + any vault node-block rent; curator only signs.

accounts.name: feePayer
docs: Tx fee payer + rent funder for any node-block expansion.

instructions.name: CancelOrderForRiskProfile
docs: Curator cancels a vault order. Split-payer: feePayer covers tx fee (no expansion happens); curator only signs.

instructions.name: UpdateOrderForRiskProfile
docs: Curator updates a vault order via cancel-and-replace. Split-payer: feePayer covers tx fee + any rent if expansion fires; curator only signs.

accounts.name: feePayer
docs: Tx fee payer + rent funder for any node-block expansion.

instructions.name: ClaimCuratorFee
docs: Curator withdraws accrued fee atoms to a wallet ATA. Curator-gated.

instructions.name: SettleMaturedLoan
docs: Permissionless: settle a loan past `matures_at + grace`.

accounts.name: debtOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic debt-oracle slice.

accounts.name: collateralOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic collateral-oracle slice.

instructions.name: LiquidateLoan
docs: Permissionless: liquidate a loan whose current LTV breaches maintenance.

accounts.name: debtOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic debt-oracle slice.

accounts.name: collateralOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic collateral-oracle slice.

instructions.name: ProtocolFeeClaim
docs: Drain accumulated protocol fee shares to protocol_admin's debt-token ATA.
Gating on market.admin would let every per-market admin siphon protocol

accounts.name: debtOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic debt-oracle slice.

instructions.name: ClaimRepaymentForRiskProfile
docs: Permissionless cranker: realise a fully-repaid risk-profile loan.
The vault-settle loader reads exactly one bank_oracle

instructions.name: TransferMarketAdmin
docs: Initiate market admin transfer. Signer must equal current admin.

instructions.name: AcceptMarketAdmin
docs: Finalise market admin transfer. Signer must equal pending_admin.

instructions.name: CreateGlobalConfig
docs: One-shot. Allocates `[b"global_config"]`; signer must equal the BPF upgrade authority.

accounts.name: programData
docs: BpfLoaderUpgradeable::ProgramData PDA for the yDelta program.

instructions.name: ReleaseSeatForRiskProfile
docs: Tear down an empty vault-owned ClaimedSeat in a market. Curator-gated; split-payer: feePayer covers tx fee, curator only signs.

instructions.name: SyncMarketSeatsForRiskProfile
docs: Permissionless: re-stamp risk_profile_max_ltv_bps caches across up to 8 markets.

instructions.name: ConvertP2PoolToFixed
docs: Borrower-initiated refinance of a P2Pool loan into Fixed loans.

accounts.name: debtOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic debt-oracle slice.

accounts.name: collateralOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic collateral-oracle slice.

instructions.name: CheckLtvLiquidatable
docs: Read-only sim gate. Ok iff the loan would fail marginfi maint solvency.

accounts.name: debtOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic debt-oracle slice.

accounts.name: collateralOracle
docs: First entry of the variadic collateral-oracle slice.

instructions.name: CheckMaturityLiquidatable
docs: Read-only sim gate. Ok iff past `matures_at + grace` AND outstanding > 0.

accounts.name: MarketFixed
docs: Fixed 512-byte header; followed by hypertree dynamic region.

accounts.name: UserAccountFixed
docs: PDA seeds `[b"user", owner]`; followed by hypertree blocks.

accounts.name: GlobalVaultFixed
docs: Per-mint global vault. PDA seeds `[b"vault", mint]`.

types.name: LoanState
docs: 1 and 2 are reserved for future intermediate states.

types.name: FeeConfig
docs: Per-market fee policy. Embedded in MarketFixed at offset 212.

fields.name: sharePriceSnapshotBytes
docs: fp48 share-price; declared as `[u8;16]` because the field lands at offset 90 (not u128-aligned).
